title: Better Policies, Worse Verifier Audits
abstract: arXiv:2610.29029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verifier stacks increasingly sit inside post-training and test-time compute loops. We study a specific control loop: a component verifier is evaluated on fresh policy outputs against the full success label and refreshed when that aggregate score falls. For a conjunctive target $y = F \wedge M$, its on-policy AUC is $(1-q)A_{\mathrm{own}} + qA_{\mathrm{cross}}$, where $q = \Pr[F=1 \mid y=0]$. As the policy masters $F$, $q$ can rise toward one, removing weight from $F$-failures and rewarding information about $M$. We call this on-policy audit collapse. We derive a sharp identified set, a complete-erasure threshold, and the exact point at which the audit can prefer a worse component verifier; its population optimum is the full-outcome predictor, not the component oracle. translated_title: 更好的策略，更差的验证器审计
translated_abstract: 验证器堆栈越来越多地嵌入到后训练与测试时计算循环之中。我们研究了一种特定的控制回路：组件验证器在策略新生成的输出上针对完整成功标签进行评估，当该聚合分数下降时便进行刷新。对于合取目标 $y = F \wedge M$，其同策略AUC为 $(1-q)A_{\mathrm{own}} + qA_{\mathrm{cross}}$，其中 $q = \Pr[F=1 \mid y=0]$。随着策略逐渐掌握 $F$，$q$ 可能趋近于一，从而去除 $F$ 失败样本的权重，并奖励有关 $M$ 的信息。我们将这一现象称为“同策略审计崩塌”。我们推导出了清晰的识别集、完全擦除阈值，以及审计可能偏好更差组件验证器的确切临界点；其总体最优解是完整结果预测器，而非组件预言机。精确的预言机展示了这种崩塌现象，一个自然的多标签文本对照实验表明，在观察到的失败混合下，反演可能会选出具有更低规范 $F$-AUC 的头部……
tldr: 本文揭示了在策略改进闭环中，随着策略掌握部分子目标，基于聚合分数的组件验证器审计会出现“同策略审计崩塌”现象，导致审计反而偏好更差的验证器，并给出了精确的识别集、完全擦除阈值与崩塌临界点的理论刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies an "on-policy audit collapse" phenomenon in policy-improvement loops, where aggregate-score audits of component verifiers can paradoxically prefer worse verifiers as the policy masters subgoals, and derives sharp identified sets, complete-erasure thresholds, and the exact inversion point characterizing this failure mode.
